## make a simple regression model

```{r}
bears <- read.csv(file="BEARS.csv",header = TRUE)
#adjust factors to be factors
bears$SEX<- as.factor(bears$SEX)
bears$MONTH<- as.factor(bears$MONTH)
```

## Model AGE ~ NECK

```{r}
M2 <- lm(AGE~NECK,data=bears)
plot(AGE~NECK,data=bears)
abline(M2)
summary.lm(M2)
```

The plot shows a positive linear relationship between AGE and NECK.
The adjusted R-squared from the model output is ______.

## Compare Models

The better model is determined using Adjusted R-squared.
The model with the larger Adjusted R-squared explains more variation in AGE.
